name: Getcho
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description:
Getcho runs same day delivery, local distribution and shipping for stores, brands and 3PLs, on the right fleet for every order.

Stores and 3PLs connect Shopify, their POS or warehouse system, and Getcho books the right courier for each order (Uber Direct, DoorDash Drive, Roadie, local couriers and freight), then handles tracking texts, live monitoring, a delivery analysis on every drop off, ID checks and claims. Customers include Janovic, 67 Wine, Myers of Keswick and Parsel.
one_liner: Same day delivery and shipping for stores, brands and 3PLs
